terminos_titulo: Terms and Conditions of Psychological Care & Workshops
terminos_desc: Learn about the ethical guidelines, modalities of care, confidentiality, and professional standards governing every clinical consultation and workshop with Lic. Sofia Reynaga.
vigencia_nota: Effective pursuant to the Code of Ethics of the College of Psychologists of Peru and Mental Health Law No. 30947.
clausula_1_desc: Consultorio Psicologico America is led by Lic. Sofia Reynaga Pachas, Board Certified Psychologist with C.Ps.P. No. 49425. All sessions comply with professional ethical and deontological standards in Peru.
clausula_2_desc: We provide in-person clinical consultations at our private office in Villa El Salvador (America Clinic) and online sessions via secure Google Meet HD links for patients nationwide and abroad.
clausula_3_desc: All information shared during assessments, therapy sessions, and workshops is strictly protected by professional confidentiality, except in legally mandated cases of imminent risk to self or others.
clausula_4_desc: Individual and couples sessions last 50 minutes. Patients are asked to arrive on time, with a maximum 10-minute grace period to make full use of therapeutic time.
clausula_5_desc: Appointments may be rescheduled without penalty by notifying via WhatsApp or phone at least 24 hours in advance.
clausula_6_desc: Our clinical practice applies scientifically validated frameworks including Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) and Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), tailored to each patient's goals.
clausula_7_desc: Payment methods include Yape, Plin, Bank Transfer, and cash in office. Official electronic receipts (RHE) and sales boletas are issued in accordance with SUNAT regulations.
clausula_8_desc: Group workshops maintain limited capacity to guarantee personalized interaction. Practical dynamics and materials are included in registration.
clausula_9_desc: When specialized medical or psychiatric consultation is recommended, coordinated referrals are discussed with the patient in full transparency.
clausula_10_desc: All clinical practices are governed by the General Health Law No. 26842, the Mental Health Law No. 30947, and the deontological regulations of the College of Psychologists of Peru.
